text:
Morgan: quick sync — PR #842 updates the usage payloads. added new fields to make token attribution explicit for cached prefixes and streaming. want a quick compatibility sanity check before i merge.
Tess: can you summarize the concrete field changes? worried about clients parsing/renaming fields.
Morgan: short summary: we keep prompt_tokens & completion_tokens (unchanged). new fields: `chargeable_tokens` (int), `cached_prefix_tokens` (int), `cached_completion_tokens` (int), and `token_lineage_id` (string) for dedup/reconciliation. old field `cached_count` is kept as an alias for now.
Sam: streaming question: when a response streams and we hit a cached prefix, how should clients compute billed tokens? e.g., they currently add prompt + completion as shown in UI reports.
Morgan: good q. rule we implemented: chargeable_tokens = prompt_tokens + completion_tokens - cached_prefix_tokens - cached_completion_tokens. streaming still reports prompt_tokens as the model saw them. we compute cached_* server-side so clients don't need to detect cache hits.
Ryan: for accounting exports, do you want us to switch to `chargeable_tokens` as the canonical billed metric? our reconciliation jobs read `prompt_tokens`/`completion_tokens` today.
Morgan: yes — billing should use `chargeable_tokens`. for a transition period we will surface both (old fields + chargeable_tokens). we also emit `token_lineage_id` so accounting can join stream-level events to cached artifact logs. here's an example payload we plan to send:
```json
{
  "prompt_tokens": 120,
  "completion_tokens": 80,
  "cached_prefix_tokens": 30,
  "cached_completion_tokens": 0,
  "chargeable_tokens": 170,
  "token_lineage_id": "tl_abc123",
  "cached_origin": "kv-cache-v2"
}
```
Tess: ok. timeline? if we keep aliases for 6 months, we should add a clear deprecation header in the docs. also add a note about floating-point rounding for token weight (some clients do math with floats).
billing-bot: usage-exporter: schema v3 (includes chargeable_tokens, token_lineage_id, cached_origin) deployed to staging on 2026-03-01. :hammer_and_wrench:
Sam: PTAL @Morgan on PR #842 — i left a couple of comments about naming (cached_completion_tokens vs cached_output_tokens). also: add one integration test for streaming+cache case. :eyes:
Morgan: ack — i'll rename to `cached_output_tokens` in the PR (less ambiguous) and add the integration test. will also add a compatibility header `X-Usage-Schema: v3` to responses so middlewares can gate behavior.
Ryan: for reconciliation job: plan to switch to chargeable_tokens on the next run after the migration flag is flipped. i'll coordinate with finance for a cutover date.
Morgan: next steps: 1) update PR to use `cached_output_tokens` + tests (today), 2) docs + deprecation note + migration SQL snippet (tomorrow), 3) staging export verification & accounting dry-run (end of week). flag me if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
